paite: Hiai ziak in kei Paul, nou Zentelte ziak a Khrist Jesu hentapa in,
heading: Khrist A Pathian Thuguk
english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

paite: noute a dia Pathian hehpihna nasepna piak a om ka hihdan na za thamta ding uhi.
english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

paite: Huchi a kilakna tungtawn a Khrist thuguk ka kiang a theihsak a a-omdante; tuma a tomchik a ka gelh bang in.
english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

paite: Huai na sim un Khrist thuguk ka theihdan na thei ding uhi.
english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

paite: Tu hun a asawltak siangthoute leh azawlnei siangthoute kiang ah Kha theihsak a a-om bang in, tuma lam in mihing tate kiang ah theihsak in a-om ngei kei hi.
english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

paite: Huai thuguk hiai ahi, tanchinhoih ziak in Khrist Jesu ah, Zentelte gouluahpihte, pumpi hiangte leh thuchiam tanpihte ahi uhi.
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

paite: Athilhihtheihna nasepdan bang a, Pathian hehpihna thawnpiak bang zel in huai tanchinhoih nasemtu ding a bawl ka hi.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

paite: Kei, misiangthou tengteng lak a neupen sang a neuzaw kiang ah, hiai hehpihna piak ahi, Khrist hauhsakna suikhiak vual louh Zentelte kiang a gen ding in;
english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

paite: huan Pathian thil bangkim siampa a tangtawn a sel a na om, thuguk kisel bang ahia chih mi tengteng musak ding in,
english: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

paite: Pathian pilna chiteng van munte a kumpi vaihawmte leh thuneihnate kiang a saptuamte zang a, tu hun a theihsak ahihna ding in.
english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

paite: Hiai atangtawn thiltup dungzui a Toupa Khrist Jesu a atup leh sepdan ahi.
english: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

paite: Khrist Jesu i gin ziak in amah mah ah maingalna leh kimuanna toh luttheihna i nei hi.
english: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

paite: Huchi in noute ziak a ka gimthuak ziak in lungke lou ding in ka hon ngen hi, huaite na thupina uh ahi.
english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

paite: Huaiziak in i Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa ma ah ka khukdin hi,
heading: Ephesate A Ding A Paul Thumna
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: lei leh van a inkuan chiteng min phuahkhiakna pa,
english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

paite: athupina hauhdan bang zel a, ama Kha ziak a mihing sunglam a thilhihtheihna a hihhat a ahon omsak theihna ding in.
english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

paite: Huan na lungtang ua Khrist ginna a atentheihna ding in, a-itna a noute zungkai leh kingakna nei a na omtheihna ding un,
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

paite: misiangthou tengteng toh azatdan, asaudan, asandan leh athukdan theihchet theihna leh,
english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

paite: Khrist itna theih phak louh, Pathian taangchinna chiteng bang a hihdim a na omtheihna ding un.
english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

paite: Huan eimah a sem zel thilhihtheihna bang in, i nget leh i ngaihtuah tengteng sang a thupizaw tham hihtheipa kiang ngei ah,
english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

paite: tangtawn in suan tengteng tan in, saptuamte leh Khrist Jesu ah thupina om hen, Amen.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
